| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ὣς δ’ αὔτως (20.238, Εὔμαιος ἐπεύξατο; "and in just the same way") | "So in the same way" | "In the same way" | "just so" and "without more ado" (the renderings of αὔτως alone), "likewise", "similarly" |
| τὸν δ’ αὖτε προσέειπε βοῶν ἐπιβουκόλος ἀνήρ (20.235, reply-formula naming the speaker by a description) | "Him then in turn addressed the man, the herdsman of the cattle:" | "Then the herdsman of the cattle spoke to him in turn:" | "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο); "overseer of the cattle" (ἐπί- is kept inside "herdsman") |
| ὅς ῥα τότε μνηστῆρσιν ὑπερφιάλοισι μετηύδα (20.291, whole-line speech introduction) | "he then among the overweening suitors spoke:" | "He now spoke among the overweening suitors:" | "addressed" (reserved for προσέειπε / προσέφη), "answered"; ὑπερφίαλος keeps the table's "overweening" |
| καί μιν πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπεν (20.261, half-line speech introduction) | "and to him a speech he said:" | "and spoke to him:" | "addressed him with a word" (reserved for προσέειπε), "said these words" (that would be ἔπεα), "and spoke a word" (reserved for ἔπος τ’ ἔφατ’) |
| κέρδεα νωμῶν (20.257, of Telemachus; νωμάω "ply, handle", also "deal out" at 20.252) | "turning over cunning ways" | "turning over cunning ways" | "knowing cunning" (that is κέρδεα οἶδεν), "plotting", "pondering schemes"; κέρδεα keeps "cunning ways" as in the κέρδεα οἶδεν row |
| ἐϋσταθής (20.258, ἐϋσταθέος μεγάρου) | "well-standing" | "sturdy" | "well-founded" and "well-built" (taken by ἐυκτίμενος), "stable" |
| ἀριστερὸς ὄρνις (20.242) | "a bird on the left" | "a bird on the left" | "a sinister bird", "an ill-omened bird" (the Greek says only "on the left"; the note says the left is the unlucky side), kept parallel to δεξιὸς ὄρνις "a bird on the right" |
| ὑψιπέτης (of an eagle, 20.243) | "high-flying" | "high-flying" | "soaring", "lofty-flying", "high-soaring" |
| ἀθεμίστια εἰδώς (20.287, of Ctesippus) | "knowing lawless things" | "who knew lawless ways" | "knowing no law", "of impious mind", "wicked"; follows ἀθεμίστια "lawless things" / "lawless ways" (9.189) |
| λαίφεα (20.206, τοιάδε λαίφε’ ἔχοντα) | "rags" | "rags" | "tattered cloak", "sails" (the other sense of λαῖφος), "garments" |
| λοετροχόος (substantival, 20.297, λοετροχόῳ) | "bath-pourer" | "the servant who pours the bath-water" | "bath-attendant", "bath-maid" (the Greek names the pouring, not the person's rank) |
| ἐπιβουκόλος (20.235) | "herdsman" (in the formula above) | "herdsman" | "overseer", "cowherd over" |
| Φιλοίτιος · Κτήσιππος · Κεφαλλῆνες (20.199–298) | Philoetius · Ctesippus · the Cephallenians | same | "Philoitios", "Ktesippos", "Kephallenians" (the familiar Latinised forms, as for the other names in the table) |
